_meta.description: Dated ground photos, by the owner or by people who gave permission to use them. Entries with kind "drone" are stills from a drone video by a creator who gave permission (the main flight is in aerial.json; the Phase 1 stills come from the creator's January 2026 flight); video_t is the second in the video, and source_url opens the video there. 'pairs' are before/after pairs shown under the satellite comparison. 'stations' holds photos for each station page, keyed by the station id in stations.json. Put the image files in public/photos/ (location data removed) and add entries below. See UPDATING.md.

dahisar-east.alt: Drone view of two elevated stations side by side at Dahisar East, one with a yellow roof and one with a red roof, with the viaducts running between buildings
dahisar-east.caption: The Line 9 station, red roof, beside Line 2A's, yellow roof, before Phase 1 opened

pandurang-wadi.alt: Drone view along the viaduct to the red-roofed Pandurang Wadi station above a busy road, with cleared land on the right
pandurang-wadi.caption: The station above the road, before Phase 1 opened

miragaon.alt: Drone view of the red-roofed Miragaon station on the viaduct beside the highway flyover, with towers on the right, in haze
miragaon.caption: The station beside the highway, before Phase 1 opened

kashigaon.alt: Drone view of the viaduct curving towards the red-roofed Kashigaon station, with a train on the curve and hills behind
kashigaon.caption: The line curves into Kashigaon, the end of the open stretch

sai-baba-nagar.alt: Drone view looking straight down the tracks inside the station's steel roof frame, with the platform slabs on each side
sai-baba-nagar.caption: Tracks and platforms inside the station, from above

meditiya-nagar.alt: Drone view of the long red station roof on the viaduct, between blue-roofed housing blocks
meditiya-nagar.caption: The roof sheeting on, from above

shahid-bhagat-singh-garden.alt: Drone view along the viaduct to the station's bare steel roof frame, between high-rise housing, with green land beyond
shahid-bhagat-singh-garden.caption: The station's steel roof frame, not yet clad

subhash-chandra-bose-stadium.alt: Drone view of the end of the viaduct at the station site, beside buildings under construction, with mangroves and open land beyond
subhash-chandra-bose-stadium.caption: The end of the line at the station site, from above
